theorems.name: Submission.approxTangent_le_submanifold_tangentSpace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (N M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N → x ∈ N → μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ tangentSpace N x
